description: Four-minute Le Mans Ultimate AI race at Laguna Seca, captured from the LMU_Data shared-memory block and the local REST API
anonymisationNotes: Driver names, the player name, the server name and the .PLR filename were replaced by lmu_replay anonymise; the scoring stream was zeroed. Replacement covers the full name in four JSON encodings and the initial-and-surname spelling LMU's pit menu uses. No Steam IDs are present.
